Right on time. I'll deliver Her Majesty's decree now.
Here. The seal will disappear as soon as you touch it.
strings.(레나의 말대로 문서에 손을 댄 순간, 봉인이 녹아 사라진다.): (Just as Lena said, the seal melts away the moment you touch the document.)
strings.제국 마법청의 특허 기술 중에 하나다. 받는 이의 정보를 입력해 만든 봉: One of the Imperial Magic Bureau's patented techniques. The seal is made using the recipient's information... Only the intended recipient can open it.
But how do they enter that information? How do they know who I am...?
strings.내가 마법청이 하는 일까진 자세하겐 알지 못한다. 이만, 폐하의 메시지를: I don't know the details of the bureau's work. Now, read Her Majesty's message.
strings.「친애하는 여신의 심부름꾼이여. 당신과 여신에게 필요한 힘이 모로스에 있: 'Dear messenger of the goddess. The power you and your goddess need lies in Moros.'
strings.「프레이오스와 이스트랜드를 고통스럽게 만든 '남매'를 찾으면 진실에 가까: 'Find the siblings who have brought suffering to Freios and Eastland, and you will draw closer to the truth.'
strings.「실바리아 제국 황제 - 카이나 던 실바리아….」: 'Empress of the Silvaria Empire—Kaina Dawn Silvaria...'
strings.(폐하의 존함, 오랜만에 듣는군….): (It's been a while since I heard Her Majesty's full name...)
strings.레나 씨, 그럼 제가 이제 어떻게 해야 하는 건가요?: Lena, what am I supposed to do now?
Whether you follow Her Majesty's wishes is up to you.
strings.황명인데, 거스를 수 있을 거라 생각해요?: It's an imperial order. Do you think I can disobey it?
strings.후후. 그건 알아서 해. 자세한 건 길드 연합 도시, 중심부 '에스닐'로: Hehe. Decide for yourself. For the details, enter Esnil, the center of the Guild Union city, and meet Director Dayna.
She'll tell you what to do. I'll be off, then...
The power we need... I can't keep this to myself. Iris...? Iris, are you listening? Could we talk for a moment?
strings.(이리스에게 레나와 나눴던 이야기를 전한다.): (You tell Iris about your conversation with Lena.)
strings.정확히 알 수는 없지만, 그쪽에 강한 힘이 느껴져요. 초인인지 아닐지 잘: I can't tell exactly, but I sense a strong power there. I don't know whether it belongs to a Champion, but I do think someone is there...
Then I'll have to go and see for myself... There are things I want to find out, too.
All right... I'm counting on you.
...I was going to tell her not to worry.
strings.레나 씨가 데이나라는 사람에게 가면 알 수 있다고 했으니 안으로 들어가보: Lena said someone named Dayna would know. I'd better head inside.
strings.(에스닐이라고 불리는 길드 연합 도시의 중심가. 길드 연합 본부 건물로: (Esnil, the central district of the Guild Union city. A woman of refined bearing stands before a tower that appears to be the union's headquarters.)
strings.(여성이 서류로 보이는 문서를 확인하더니 한숨을 내쉰다.): (The woman examines what looks like a stack of paperwork, then sighs.)
Sigh. Things got complicated while I was away for a moment... My sister again...
strings.저기, 데이나 총장님이신가요?: Excuse me. Are you Director Dayna?
strings.아, 당신이군. 기다리고 있었어. 레나 경에게서 들었어. 여신의 일을 하: Oh, it's you. I've been waiting. Dame Lena told me about you. You work for the goddess. Your name is %s, right?
strings.내 인사가 늦었어. 나는 데이나. 길드 연합의 총책임자인 '총장'이면서: Sorry for the late introduction. I'm Dayna, director of the Guild Union and master of the Storm Watchers Guild.
The Storm Watchers Guild? That's Einst's...
Yes, exactly. Thank you for taking care of all the things Einst asked of you.
strings.총장이란 직책 말고, 이름을 불러주면 좋겠어. 격식 따지는 걸 좋아하지: I'd rather you used my name than my title. I'm not fond of formality.
Of course, Director Day— I mean, Dayna.
strings.좋아. 나도 %s 씨라고 부를게. 괜찮지?: Good. Then I'll call you %s as well. Is that all right?
Yes, that's fine. Let's get to the point.
strings.레나 씨가 데이나 씨한테 가면 된다고는 했는데…, 그 다음에 어떻게 해야: Lena told me to see you... But what am I supposed to do next?
Her Majesty has approved you, and you've received permission to enter Esnil, but...
You're unsure because you don't know what sort of person I am.
Yes, exactly. I start by being suspicious of anyone I haven't dealt with myself. Otherwise, how can I know?
It's only natural, so don't take it personally.
strings.저도 늘 그래요. 사실 데이나 씨도 어떤 사람인지 모르니까요. 그러니까: I'm the same way. I don't really know what sort of person you are either. So what can we do to earn each other's trust?
strings.후후, 직접적으로 말해줘서 고마워. 그럼 나부터 %s 씨에게 믿음을 줘야: Hehe. Thank you for being direct. Then I should give you a reason to trust me first, %s.
strings.(데이나가 품 안에서 검은 카드 한 장을 꺼낸다.): (Dayna takes a black card from inside her coat.)
strings.이 카드에 내가 서명하고, %s 씨가 무한회랑의 도움을 받아 마력을 인증: Once I sign this card and you authenticate your magic with the Infinite Corridor's help, %s...
You'll receive every privilege the Empire offers, including those of Esnil, the Guild Union city.
You'll officially be someone recognized by Empress Kaina of the Silvaria Empire.
strings.%s 씨는 '우리'에게 실력을 보여줘. 실력을 보여주는 것만큼 확실한 건: In return, %s, show 'us' what you can do. Nothing is more convincing than a demonstration of skill.
Yes, us. 'Moonlight.' You don't need the details, so don't worry about it.
strings.라클렛에게 맡긴 일이 있어. 그러니 함께 다녀와. 그곳에서 라클렛이 본: There's a job I've assigned to Raclette. Go with him. He'll report what he sees there, and you can prove yourself that way.
It could be difficult, or easy, depending on how you look at it. Now, Raclette.
Director, I'm feeling perfectly relaxed right now...
Oh, sorry. I've seen that expression for years, and I'm still not used to it.
strings.그러면 거기 가서 그 물건을 구해오면 됩니까?: Then we just need to go there and retrieve the item?
strings.혼자서는 어려울 것 같으니, %s 씨와 함께 다녀와. 아무래도 그곳은 죽: It might be difficult alone, so take %s with you. After all, the presence of the dead still lingers there.
strings.평소에 알고 계실 수도 있는 곳이지만, 저하고 갈 때는 다를 겁니다. 이: It may be somewhere you know, but it will be different when you go with me. Come along.
strings.(평소에 알고 있는 곳이지만, 갈 때는 다르다는 말은 뭐지, 대체…?): (What does he mean, a place I know that will be different when I go with him...?)
Well done. We also obtained what we needed.
strings.무슨 생각을 그렇게 하시죠?: What are you thinking so hard about?
strings.그게 전에도 가본 곳이었지만…. 오늘은 뭔가 달랐어요. 마치 다른 공간에: I've been there before, but... something was different today. As though we'd entered another space...
So you sensed it clearly. Someone chosen by a goddess really is different...
Though we're different from other people too...
strings.다르다는 게 뭐죠?: What do you mean by different?
strings.그런 건 데이나 총장이 이야기해 줄 겁니다. 어쨌든 저는 제대로 된 신의: Director Dayna will explain that. In any case, I've felt true divine power now, and that's enough...
Your abilities were excellent. Once I send you back, the director will handle things. Take this book to her while you're there...
strings.그렇군요. 아, 이 책…. 거기서 구한 거죠?: I see. Oh, this book... You found it there?
strings.분명 예전엔 구할 수 없었는데, 어째서 라클렛하고 갔을 땐 나타난 걸까요: I couldn't find anything like it before. Why did it appear when I went with you?
strings.같은 세계라고 해도 다른 면이 존재하는데, 저희는 운 좋게 그 중 하나를: Even the same world has different facets. We're fortunate enough to see one of them and enter it... I'll only say that it's distorted.
I need to sort out the shipments that piled up while we were away. Go straight to the director. She'll be waiting.
All right. But what's this cake here? It looks delicious.
strings.젤릭 녀석이 또 케이크를 놓고 갔네, 귀찮아라…. 아, 혹시 디저트 좋아: Zellic left another cake. What a bother... Oh, do you like desserts?
If it's tasty, I like it.
Perfect. Take all of it. I'll be off...
W-wait, Raclette. This is far too much! He's gone...
Sigh. Then I'd better see Dayna.
No. We found a book there and brought it back.
strings.고마워. 이게 '우리'에게 필요했었는데, 좀처럼 나타나지 않아서 애를 먹: Thank you. 'We' needed this, but it simply wouldn't turn up. It's been quite a struggle.
Then you appeared, and thanks to you, we were able to find it. I'm truly grateful.
strings.이거…, 길드 연합의 일은 아니었죠?: This... wasn't Guild Union business, was it?
Correct. Now put that suspicious look aside for a moment. I'll explain everything.
strings.세계를 감싸고 있는 건 빛뿐만이 아닌 어둠도 있어. 사람들이 기억하는 건: The world is enveloped in darkness as well as light. But people remember only the light, and believe that light alone is the truth.
strings.빛도, 어둠도 세계의 일부인데 말이야. 사실, 모든 존재는 고유의 진리를: Light and darkness are both parts of the world. In fact, every existence has a truth of its own.
strings.어둠은 빛을 맞이하고 '모두에게 안식을 주는 진리'를 품고 있어. 하지만: Darkness welcomes the light and holds the truth that grants rest to all. Yet at some point, the world began to fear any place where darkness gathered thickly.
strings.그런 어둠을 나쁜 이들이 이용하면서 결국 '악'으로 만들어 버렸어. 사실: Wicked people exploited that darkness until they made it 'evil.' There is darkness that isn't evil, yet even that was denied...
strings.(데이나의 손 끝에서 어둠의 파장이 흘러나온다. 파장은 데이나를 감싸고: (Waves of darkness flow from Dayna's fingertips. They rise around her, then vanish.)
strings.후후, 부정당한 존재의 증거라고 해두지. 믿을 수 있는 대상에게 보여주는: Hehe. Call it proof of an existence that was denied. I only show it to people I can trust. You must have a secret or two yourself, don't you?
strings.뭘 어떻게 알고 있는 거죠, 데이나?: What do you know, Dayna? And how?
strings.언니가 힌트를 준 것뿐인데, 맞았나 보네. 그냥 지레짐작해본 거니까 너무: My sister only gave me a hint. Looks like I guessed right. It was just a shot in the dark, so don't worry too much about it.
strings.그 사람은 때가 되면 만날 거야. 그건 그렇고 우리의 힘을 보고 좀 놀랐: You'll meet her when the time comes. Anyway, our power startled you a little, didn't it? It's only slightly distorted. Don't be afraid.
strings.많이 놀라진 않았어요. 이런 일들이 은근 주위에 많아서 이젠 그냥 그런가: I wasn't that startled. Things like this happen around me so often that I just accept them now.
strings.후후, 재미있는 사람이네. 이제 이 카드 받아. 이걸로 당신은 좀 더 특: Hehe. You're an interesting person. Here, take this card. With it, you've become a little more special.
strings.고마워요, 데이나. 이제 전 어떻게 할까요?: Thank you, Dayna. What should I do now?
strings.이제 %s 씨가 갈 곳이 있어. 알고 있을지 모르겠지만, 연합군이 있는: There's somewhere you need to go now, %s. You may already know it: Moros, in Eastland, where the allied forces are stationed.
strings.모로스 지역이요? 설마 모스 왕국과도 관계가 있는 건가요?: Moros? Could this be connected to the Kingdom of Moss?
strings.맞아. 여기서 설명하면 좀 길어질 수도 있어. 그러니까 그곳에 가서 적당: Exactly. Explaining it here could take a while. Go there, deal with whatever needs dealing with along the way, and meet the Savior.
They'll tell you what's happening there.
strings.알았어요. 그런데, 거기는 어떻게 가죠?: All right. How do I get there?
strings.허공해를 가면 임페리얼 게이트가 보일 거야. 황명으로 무한회랑의 마법사들: Go to the Void Sea, and you'll see an Imperial Gate. The Infinite Corridor mages built it by imperial order.
Oh, I see. I'll be going, then.
strings.다녀오란 건…, 그곳의 일이 끝나면 돌아오라는 거군요. 그것도 폐하의 뜻: A trip... meaning I should come back once the work there is done? Is that Her Majesty's wish too?
strings.아마 그럴 수도 있겠지? 후후, 그건 신경 쓰지 말고, 눈 앞에 있는 일: Perhaps it is. Hehe. Don't worry about that. See what's in front of you first. And cut down anything that gets in your way.
strings.(저 멀리 이상한 무기를 들고 있는 세이버가 보인다. 세이버 주위에는 공: (In the distance, a Savior carrying an unusual weapon comes into view. Defeated enemies and strange creatures lie all around them.)
strings.저 사람인가? 데이나가 말한 세이버가…. 대단하네. 저 많은 적을 저렇게: Is that the Savior Dayna mentioned...? Impressive. They handled all those enemies...
strings.아, 당신이 %s..., 폐하께 말씀 들었어요. 저는 아우룸, 보시다시피: Oh, you're %s... Her Majesty told me about you. I'm Aurum, a Savior, as you can see.
strings.(홀리오더인 플라티나와는 다른 느낌이 드는 복장이다. 그리고 들고 있는: (The outfit has a different feel from Platina's Holy Order uniform. The weapon also radiates a sacred presence.)
strings.네, 아우룸…. 그런데 들고 계신 무기를 봐서는 세이버인지 잘 모르겠어요: Yes, Aurum... Though with that weapon, I couldn't really tell you were a Savior. A club with a sacred aura...?
You really are different. Hardly anyone has sensed that power in this blunt weapon...
It's like the energy of the land where Goddess Gaia stayed.
strings.그렇다면, 그곳의 신성한 나무로 만들어진 게 아닐까 싶군요. 이거야말로: Then perhaps it was made from a sacred tree there. A weapon perfectly suited to someone bearing a sacred duty, like me.
Sending enemies flying into the distance really is the best fun.
Hmm. Aurum, I don't think this is the time for that.
strings.여기 적들이 엄청나게 많은 것 같은데, 혼자서 괜찮아요?: There seem to be an awful lot of enemies here. Will you be all right alone?
strings.혼자서도 괜찮지만, 오래 걸릴 것 같아서 부탁드리고 싶군요. 여신의 망나: I can manage alone, but it would take a while, so I'd appreciate your help. Give me the chance to fight alongside the Goddess's Executioner.
You can have all the chances you like, but please forget that title. Sigh...
strings.저는 영광스럽다 생각하는 칭호인데…. 그게 어쨌든…. 황명대로 무식하게: I think it's an honorable title... In any case, you should see a blunt-weapon Savior rampage, just as Her Majesty ordered.
I'll do my best. Please take that side, %s.
strings.알았어요. 잠깐, 뭘 어떻게 한다고요? 날뛴다고요?: All right. Wait—what did you say you were going to do? Rampage?
You sensed it too, %s. An evil power... This must be...
strings.마석…. 이렇게 강하게 느껴지는 걸 보면 마석이 여러 개가 아니라는 건: Magic stones... For the feeling to be this strong, it can't be just a few of them...
If they aren't ordinary magic stones, they must belong to those two.
strings.네, 알고 있어요. 반과 마라…. 그리고 그 남매가 힘을 실어준 모스 왕: Yes. Ban and Mara... And the Kingdom of Moss, which the siblings have empowered. The allied forces are putting their strength into this, so it should be over soon.
strings.연합군에 대해서 설명해주시겠어요?: Could you explain these allied forces?
Dayna said the Savior would tell me about them.
Oh, I see. Then I'd better explain.
strings.그동안 '성역'에서는 프레이오스를 비롯해 여러 대륙에서 일어나는 일에 주: The Sanctuary has been watching events in Freios and the other continents for some time.
strings.잠들어 있던 곳을 깨우고, 탐욕 많은 자를 이용하고, 평화롭게 살던 일족: Awakening dormant places, exploiting the greedy, using a peaceful people to attack another country...
strings.악행을 일삼는 자들이 있었죠. 그들이 자신을 아가슈라라고 칭했지만, 사람: There were people committing all kinds of evil. They called themselves Agasuras, but witnesses said something about them was different.
strings.제국 폐하께서는 이를 확인하시고 곧바로 그들의 토벌을 명하셨어요. 하지만: Once Her Majesty confirmed this, she immediately ordered their defeat. But she didn't merely intend to capture them...
strings.그들과 함께 하는 모스 왕국까지 역사에서 지우기 위해 사신을 보내 여러: She sent envoys to gather various powers, intending to erase their ally, the Kingdom of Moss, from history as well.
strings.지엔디아 대륙에선 고대 지엔디아 제국의 일원들과 엘리아스 왕국이, 프레이: From Jiendia came members of the ancient Jiendia Empire and the Kingdom of Elias. From Freios came the Silvaria Empire and the Libera Free Alliance...
strings.이스트랜드에선 쥬드 왕국과 빛의 연합이…. 이렇게 많은 세력들이 모아 모: From Eastland came the Kingdom of Jude and the Alliance of Light. All these powers have joined forces against the Kingdom of Moss.
With that much strength, it seems like you could finish off the Deimos cult too.
strings.그것까진 잘 모르겠어요. 지금 연합군의 목적은 이곳 모로스에서 모스 왕국: I couldn't say. Right now, the allied forces' objective is to bring the Kingdom of Moss to an end here in Moros.
strings.일단 여러 세력의 일원들이 모로스 각 구역에 파견 나와 있어요. 저는 저: Members of the various powers are deployed throughout Moros. I have my own assigned mission as well.
strings.아우룸의 임무…, 제가 알아도 괜찮은 건가요?: Your mission... Is it all right for me to know about it, Aurum?
strings.네, 괜찮아요. 제 임무는 평소대로 전장에서 마구 날뛰는 거라고 폐하께서: Of course. Her Majesty personally told me my mission was to rampage around the battlefield as usual.
strings.(제국의 황제란 분은 어떤 사람인지 감이 오지 않는다니까….): (I still can't begin to imagine what kind of person this empress is...)
strings.%s 님은 이제 플라티나 후배님에게 가보셔야 할 것 같아요. 후배님이 마: You should go see my junior, Platina, now, %s. She's tracking the magic stones' power, but I doubt she can handle it alone.
Her Majesty said the same thing: Platina would need you, %s...
Then it must be over that way...
strings.마력 방공호라고 불리는 장소에요. 그 앞으로 가세요. 후배님이 기다리고: A place called the Magical Fallout Shelter. Go to its entrance. Platina should be waiting.
strings.네, 저는 계속해서 적들을 쓰러뜨리겠습니다!: Yes. I'll keep taking down the enemies here!
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 아우룸이 적들 사이로 뛰어 들어간다.): (Before the words are even out, Aurum leaps into the midst of the enemies.)
strings.대단한 사람이야. 그나저나 언제가 될지 모르지만, 나중에 성역에 가게 될: What a person. Still, I feel I'll be visiting the Sanctuary someday... I wonder how Platina is doing. I'd better hurry.
strings.후우, 여기에 들어갈 수 있는 방법은 없는 건가?: Sigh. Is there no way to get inside?
strings.(저쪽에서 강한 힘이 다가오는 게 느껴져…. 아우룸 선배 아니면 모험가님: (I can feel a strong power approaching... Either Aurum or the adventurer, surely...?)
strings.플라티나, 왜 여기 혼자 있어요?: Platina, why are you here alone?
strings.모험가님, 오셨군요. 여기까지 오신 걸 보니 데이나 총장님을 만나셨겠군요: Adventurer, you're here. If you've come this far, you must have met Director Dayna. And Aurum, too...
That's right. I received Her Majesty's decree...
strings.(플라티나에게 에스닐에서의 일과 아우룸을 만난 상황들을 간단하게 설명한다: (You briefly tell Platina about your time in Esnil and your meeting with Aurum.)
strings.연합군이 모스 왕국의 거점을 차지하면서 여러 마을과 세력들이 투항해왔어요: As the allied forces seized the Kingdom of Moss's strongholds, various towns and factions surrendered. The kingdom's end is close now.
strings.하지만, 탐욕스러운 왕자는 끝까지 포기하지 않는 거 같아요. 자신을 따르: But its greedy prince refuses to give up. He's supplied his loyal knights and mages with magic stones.
W-wait. If I can feel the stones' ominous power this strongly...
strings.네, 모험가님. 저 안에 엄청난 양의 마석이 있어요. 저기, 마력 방공호: Yes, adventurer. There's an enormous quantity inside. Over there, in the place called the Magical Fallout Shelter.
strings.원래 저곳은 전쟁에 지친 마을 사람들이 자신을 보호받고자 만들었던 안전: It was originally a safe haven built by war-weary villagers to protect themselves. Now Prince Nox has led his remaining soldiers inside.
strings.녹스 왕자라면 모스 왕국의 왕자인가요?: Prince Nox is the prince of Moss?
strings.네, 모스 왕국의 왕자인 그는 반과 마라를 이용해 대륙의 정벌자가 되려고: Yes. He apparently planned to use Ban and Mara to become a conqueror of the continent. When things failed to go his way, he even forced his father, King Void, to step down.
strings.연합군이 보이드 국왕을 붙잡고 녹스 왕자의 항복을 유도했지만, 왕자는 계: The allied forces captured King Void and tried to persuade Prince Nox to surrender, but he kept holding out in the shelter.
strings.그러다 마법사 하나가 나와 보이드 국왕을 살해했고, 전과는 다른 힘으로: Then a mage emerged, killed King Void, and defeated half the allied troops here with a power unlike anything we'd seen before.
It was the magic stones. They're wielding dozens, hundreds of them. Their power is truly...
strings.모험가님께서 타르타로스에서 란다인이란 사람을 쓰러뜨렸다고 들었어요. 란다: I heard you defeated a man named Randaine in Tartaros. Unlike Randaine, who was consumed by the stones, Prince Nox overcame their influence himself.
...If only I could get inside, I would fight him...
strings.무슨 말이에요? 플라티나가 왜 들어갈 수 없단 거죠?: What do you mean? Why can't you go inside, Platina?
strings.결계가 펼쳐져 있어요. 연합군의 마법사들이 힘을 합쳤지만, 저희는 허락되: There's a barrier. The allied mages combined their power, but we still weren't allowed through.
strings.아마도 폐하가 %s 님을 이끈 건 이런 이유겠죠. 모험가님, 이 안에서: Perhaps this is why Her Majesty brought you here, %s. Adventurer, please go inside and bring Prince Nox down.
You should be able to enter and reach him.
strings.차라리 이야기를 듣지 않고 이곳에 왔으면 더 좋았을 텐데, 괜히 찜찜하네: I'd almost rather have come here without hearing all this. It's left a bad taste in my mouth.
strings.폐하는 대체 무슨 생각이시죠? 아니, 어떤 분이신가요? 갑자기 내가, 아: What is Her Majesty thinking? No, what kind of person is she? Suddenly I feel like a chess piece—and so does everyone here.
strings.플라티나가 미안해할 필요 없어요. 이게 다…. 아니, 언젠가 폐하를 뵙고: You don't need to apologize, Platina. All of this... No. Someday, I want to meet Her Majesty and ask her myself.
Just as there are things I want to ask Iris...
strings.너무 걱정 마세요. 이것도 예정된 일이라면 제가 이기겠죠. 그럼 다녀올게: Don't worry too much. If this is all destined to happen, I'll win. I'll be going, then.
strings.내 친히 정예 기사들과 마법사들을 보냈는데, 내 앞에 서있을 수 있다니: I sent my elite knights and mages against you, yet here you stand before me. Impressive. You have my praise. Now, what is your name?
How insolent. Who do you think I am? I am...
strings.닥쳐, 무례한 건 당신이야. 당신이 누구든 간에 세상에 해를 끼친 건 틀: Shut up. You're the insolent one. Whoever you are, there's no denying the harm you've done to the world. So many people have bled because of you. Do you understand?
strings.이건 대의를 위한 일, 내 의지는 이 땅을 넘어 프레이오스에 새겨질 것이: This is for a greater cause. My will shall be etched into Freios, beyond this land. Nothing can be accomplished in this accursed place.
History will recognize one who does great things.
strings.당신이 가진 힘이 온전히 당신 거라 생각해? 태어날 때부터 왕자란 지위에: Do you think that power is truly yours? Born a prince, wielding false strength from magic stones... Don't delude yourself!
Fine. I'll give you credit for one thing: you haven't been consumed by the stones.
strings.칭찬인가? 고맙다고 해두지. 그리고 잠식당하는 것은 약한 자들에게나 어울: A compliment? Then I shall thank you. Being consumed is a fate fit only for the weak. I have no need of such a process.
strings.그 말, 후회하게 해줄게. 어차피 내가 이름 이야기해도 중요하게 생각하지: I'll make you regret saying that. I doubt you'd care about my name even if I told you...
strings.흐음, 그럼 약속 하나 할까? 내가 널 쓰러뜨리면 알려줄게. 여기서 나쁜: Hmm. Shall we make a promise? If I defeat you, I'll tell you. This is where the wicked prince scoffs and says that will never happen, right?
strings.그런 뻔한 이야기를 잘도 하는 걸 보니 천박하군. 나는 절대 약하지 않다: How vulgar, to spout such trite words. I am not weak. And I will do anything to restore the glory of the Kingdom of Moss.
strings.후우, 그럼 해볼까…? 어차피 예정된 일이긴 하지만, 마음대로 하게 두진: Sigh. Shall we begin, then? This may be destined, but I won't let you have your way!
strings.(녹스 왕자의 품에서 불길한 힘을 품은 마석이 산산조각나며 떨어진다.): (Magic stones filled with sinister power shatter and fall from Prince Nox's clothing.)
I thought these stones would make my dream come true. Was I wrong...?
strings.이 인간이고, 저 인간이고 왜 다들 이런 힘에 집착하는 거야?: You, him, everyone... Why are you all so obsessed with this kind of power?
strings.어차피 내가 이길 운명? 그런거면 왜 이리 힘들게 이겨야 하는 거야?: I'm destined to win? Then why does victory have to be this hard?
strings.난 몰라. 알고 싶지도 않고, 알려주고 싶지도 않지만, 약속한 건 알려주: I don't know. I don't want to know, and I don't want to tell you anything. But I'll keep my promise. My name is %s...
strings.쿨럭쿨럭, 쿨럭쿨럭…. 그래, 들어본 이름이었어. 반과 마라가 했던 일을: Cough... cough... Yes, I've heard that name. The divine messenger who thwarted everything Ban and Mara did and saved the Kingdom of Jude...
strings.왜 사사건건 방해하는 거지?: Why must you interfere at every turn?
strings.(무기를 든 손에 힘이 잔뜩 들어간다. 금방이라도 누군가를 해치고 싶을: (Your grip tightens around your weapon. So tightly that you feel ready to hurt someone at any moment...)
strings.나는 당신을 죽일 생각이 없어. 그냥 쓰러뜨리고 연합군에 맡기고 돌아갈: I don't intend to kill you. I was only going to defeat you, hand you over to the allied forces, and leave. S-something's wrong...
strings.크하하하하, 쿨럭쿨럭…. 네 놈, 역시 그런 건가, 아하하하. 그래, 좋: Hahahaha! Cough... So that's it, is it? Ahahaha! 'Divine messenger' is merely a flattering name. You're a puppet all the same... Cough...
Those who received divine power and followed the gods in this world destroyed themselves. You will too. The Night of the Witches won't leave you alone. And my will shall remain to curse you, again and again...
strings.(분한 표정의 녹스 왕자가 갑자기 고통을 호소하며 쓰러진다. 마석의 부작: (Prince Nox, his face twisted with resentment, suddenly collapses in agony. As a side effect of the magic stones, his arms and legs begin turning to dust, one by one.)
strings.이게 이 자의 최후인가…. 어…, 연합군?: Is this how he ends...? Oh... the allied forces?
strings.(연합군 마법사들이 서둘러 들어와 치유 마법으로 녹스 왕자의 소멸을 막는: (Allied mages rush in and use healing magic to stop Prince Nox from disintegrating. They bind him and drag him away.)
I was destined to defeat an enemy, and that's all I did... But I don't feel any better.
Sigh. I'd better go to Platina...
strings.(녹스 왕자와의 격전이 끝난 뒤, 아무도 없던 공간 뒤쪽에서 천천히 누군: (After the fierce battle with Prince Nox ends, someone slowly emerges from the back of the seemingly empty chamber.)
strings.젠장, 녹스도 그 놈을 해결하지 못했군. 이렇게 모스 왕국은 망한 건가…: Damn it. Even Nox couldn't deal with that pest. Is this the end of the Kingdom of Moss...?
strings.왜 그렇게 멍하니 있어?: Why are you just standing there in a daze?
strings.아, 아냐. 그런데 우리 이제 남은 마석 있어? 그거라도 있어야 뭐라도: N-nothing. Do we have any magic stones left? We'll need at least those if we're going to do anything.
strings.며칠 전에 설치했던 장치가 발동했으니, 그곳에서 버티면 돼. 그곳으로 가: The device we installed a few days ago has activated. We can hold out there. Let's go to Oneiro...
strings.예정대로라면 이제 다른 모습이 됐을 거야. 그리고 그곳으로 그 녀석이 들: If everything's gone as planned, it will have taken a different form by now. Once that pest steps inside, it's all over.
strings.이곳에서의 일을 끝내고 다시 프레이오스로 가자. 가서 실바리아 제국 놈들: Let's finish things here and return to Freios. We'll wipe out those Silvarian bastards all over again.
I don't know anymore. What we're doing with these stones...
Shut up. Think of everything the Silvaria Empire put us through.
Come on. Let's watch that pest's life come to an end.
You're back. With this, the Kingdom of Moss...
strings.저밖에 들어올 수 없는 공간이라더니 연합군 병사들은 대체 언제 들어온 거: You said only I could get inside. When did the allied soldiers get in?
strings.모험가님께서 마석을 가진 마법사들을 해치우기 시작하면서 결계가 약해졌고,: The barrier began weakening as you defeated the mages carrying magic stones. We took that opening and approached as closely as we could.
Then once Prince Nox's stones shattered, you were able to reach him.
strings.플라티나는 이제 내가 뭘 해야 할지 알고 있겠죠? 이 일만 끝내려고 날: Platina, you must know what I'm supposed to do now. I know I was sent here to finish this job.
I'm not blaming you. Just tell me where I need to go.
strings.모험가님께서는 오네이로 숲으로 가셔야 해요. 숲은 모로스 지역의 제일 안: You need to go to Oneiro Forest. It's at the farthest reaches of Moros.
Once I'm there, I'll know what to do.
Yes. Someone you know will be waiting there.
strings.고마워요. 아, 그러면 이제 전쟁은 어떻게 되는 건가요?: Thank you. Oh, what happens to the war now?
strings.녹스 왕자를 비롯해 남은 모스 왕국의 병사들을 모두 붙잡았어요. 이제 공: We've captured Prince Nox and all the remaining soldiers. The Kingdom of Moss officially no longer exists.
strings.이후 이 모로스 지역에 대한 관리는 빛의 연합의 맹주이신 지스카드님께서: Lord Ziskad, leader of the Alliance of Light, will oversee the Moros region from now on.
That was quick. Then I'd better make sure I finish my part properly.
strings.불편하게 만들어서 미안해요, 플라티나. 저는 이제 가볼게요. 그러면 나중: I'm sorry for making you uncomfortable, Platina. I'll be going now. See you later.
Don't worry. I've always managed well enough.
strings.(안쪽으로 가보니 익숙한 목소리가 들려온다. 적으로 인식되는 누군가와 대: (As you head farther in, you hear a familiar voice. Someone seems to be confronting an enemy.)
Damn it. I thought there'd be no one guarding Oneiro Forest...
So you were the ones who caused the explosion.
strings.호오, 좋아. 예정대로야. 이제 그곳에서…. 아니, 그보다 망한 나라의: Oh, good. Right on schedule. Now, in there... No, first I'll deal with this warrior from a fallen kingdom.
strings.(반이 주머니에서 뭔가 꺼내 진을 향해 던진다. 진의 발밑에서 떨어진 것: (Ban takes something from his pocket and throws it toward Jin. An unknown power flows from the object at Jin's feet.)
Urgh... cough... What is this...? Don't tell me... You bastards, what have you done...? I can't move...
strings.방해자는 조용히 여기서 죽어. 이 마석, 아직 시험 단계이긴 하지만, 네: Stay quiet and die here, meddler. This magic stone is still experimental, but for the likes of you...
strings.(진이 발버둥 치지만, 움직일 수 없다. 마석에서 흘러나온 힘이 서서히: (Jin struggles, unable to move. Power from the magic stone rises slowly around him.)
strings.(반이 만족한 표정을 지어 보이고 마라와 함께 서둘러 오네이로 숲으로 들: (With a satisfied look, Ban hurries into Oneiro Forest with Mara.)
To end so meaninglessly... I haven't even had my revenge...
strings.(무기를 들어 진을 묶고 있는 속박의 기운을 파괴한다.): (You raise your weapon and destroy the binding energy holding Jin.)
strings.후우…, 고맙다. 이 속박에서 꺼내줘서 고맙다. 그런데 네가 어떻게 이: Whew... Thank you. Thank you for freeing me from that binding. But how could you release me from that power...?
strings.(아, 예전과 힘의 결이 다르군….): (Ah. The texture of that power is different from before...)
The power of binding... You know about it too.
We'll discuss that later. Something dangerous is happening in the forest.
So this is what I need to do. Please, tell me.
This forest is called Oneiro. The Kingdom of Moss considered it ominous and restricted access. Supposedly, a guardian deity drives away or punishes anyone with wicked intentions...
strings.나와 정찰병들이 이곳에 몇번이나 들어갔지만, 길을 잃고 다시 나올 수 밖: My scouts and I went in several times, but we kept losing our way and had to come back out.
strings.그러다 거대한 폭발이 일어났다…. 정찰병들은 그 틈을 이용해 그 곳을 확: Then there was a tremendous explosion... The scouts used that opening to investigate.
strings.마을과 숲이 폭발해 이상한 흔적이 남고, 사람들이 끔찍하게 변했다고 하더: They said the village and forest had exploded, leaving strange traces, and the people had transformed horribly...
We tried to go back and see for ourselves, but some power was already preventing us from entering. We were dragged back outside.
strings.모스 왕국군의 흔적과 알 수 없는 힘이 뒤섞여 있었다. 그래서 일단 연합: Traces of the Moss army were mixed with an unknown force. I sent someone to the allied forces and was watching the situation when...
The ones behind the magic stones arrived. Those red-haired siblings...
strings.숲의 기운이 확실히 다른 곳과 다르네요. 마치 저주 같은…. 제가 갈게요: The forest's energy is certainly different from elsewhere. Almost like a curse... I'll go. I should be able to resolve this.
If I don't at least believe that, I won't be able to do anything.
strings.그래, 납득했다. 가서 너만이 할 수 있는 걸 해. 나는 이곳에 내가 할: All right. I understand. Go and do what only you can do. I'll do my part here and wait for you.
strings.아, 그곳의 상황이 끝나면, 그곳의 상황을 알 수 있는 물건을 하나 가져: Oh, when things are settled, bring me something that will help explain what happened inside.
strings.그럴게요. 그리고 다른 이야기는 이 일이 끝나고 차라도 한잔 하면서 하시: I will. And once this is over, let's discuss the rest over a cup of tea.
strings.(오네이로 숲의 제일 안 쪽, 숨어있던 반과 마라를 찾았다.): (Deep within Oneiro Forest, you find Ban and Mara in hiding.)
You wretched bastards. I've finally found you...
strings.이 끔찍한 광경, 다 너희가 만든 거지? 마석에 가둔 사람들, 이상하게: This horrifying scene is your doing, isn't it? People imprisoned in magic stones, that girl transformed into something strange...
strings.어느 정도는 맞고, 어느 정도는 다르다. 뭐, 확실한 건 너는 지금 이곳: Partly right, partly wrong. What I can say for certain is that you're about to regret coming here.
There's a being here that hates people like you.
strings.(엄청난 굉음을 내며 앞으로 뭔가가 떨어진다. 거대한 그림자가 숲을 잔뜩: (Something crashes down ahead with a thunderous roar. It is so enormous that its shadow seems to cover the entire forest.)
strings.쿨럭, 쿨럭…. 뭐지? 골렘?: Cough... cough... What is that? A golem?
strings.(석재와 기계와 식물이 뒤섞인 수상한 괴물….): (A strange monster made of stone, machinery, and plants mixed together...)
strings.(인위적으로 만들어진 것 같은 목소리가 숲 전체에 울려 퍼진다. 아마도: (An artificial-sounding voice echoes throughout the forest. It seems to belong to the golem that identified itself as Bergelmir.)
strings.「플래닛 '에트와르'의 초기화를 준비…. 본 과정은 관리자의 허락 없이: 'Preparing to reset planet Etoile... This process cannot be canceled without administrator authorization...'
strings.몰라, 어차피 우리와 상관없어. 수호자는 우리하고 우리가 만든 마석에 손: No idea. It doesn't matter to us. The guardian can't touch us or the stones we made. You saw that.
strings.그가 그렇게 된다고 했으니까 맞을 거야. 적어도 지금까지 틀린 정보는 없: He said that's how it would work, so it must be right. At least he hasn't given us any wrong information yet.
That's true. That man... Still, having to do what he says...
strings.(반과 마라가 베르겔미르가 있는 곳을 빤히 바라보고 있다.): (Ban and Mara stare intently toward Bergelmir.)
strings.뭐야, 저놈들은…. 후우, 그냥 싸우는 수밖에 없나…? 자, 잠깐, 뭐: What's with those two...? Sigh. Do I just have to fight...? W-wait. What's happening...?
strings.(갑자기 시간이 멈춘 것 같은 기분이 든다. 시야에 보이는 베르겔미르부터: (Suddenly, time seems to stop. Bergelmir, as well as Ban and Mara hiding in the distance, all freeze.)
strings.…모험가님, 베르겔미르와 전투 전에 볼 수 있어서 다행…. 그나마 이곳은: ...Adventurer. I'm glad I reached you before your battle with Bergelmir... Fortunately, this place is part of the domain I can access...
strings.지금 그건 중요하지 않아요…. 일단 간단하게 설명…. 오네이로는 다른 시: That isn't important now... A brief explanation... Oneiro belongs to another region of space-time... I was able to impose a temporary override...
Weapons like Bergelmir are what destroyed the world in another timeline...
Bergelmir's heart... Destroy its heart, and it should stop moving...
If you want to know more about it, destroy it and visit my room.
strings.(사라스바티의 모습이 사라져 보이지 않는다. 시간이 다시 움직이는지 베르: (Sarasvati disappears. Time seems to resume, and Bergelmir begins moving again.)
strings.…저게 배드 엔딩을 만든 괴물이란 건가…?: ...So that's the monster that brought about the bad ending...?
strings.「베르겔미르가 플래닛 '에트와르'의 초기화를 시작한다. 」: 'Bergelmir is initiating the reset of planet Etoile.'
strings.베르겔미르라고 했지? 뭐가 되든 간에 난 여기서 널 쓰러뜨린다. 지금 내: Bergelmir, was it? Whatever happens, I'm taking you down right here. That's my goal now.
strings.「방해자…. 방해자 또한 초기화에 포함한다. 동의하는 걸로 간주하고 진행: 'Interference detected... The interfering entity will be included in the reset. Consent will be presumed. Proceeding... Rooooar!'
strings.(베르겔미르의 심장에 금이 가면서 움직임을 멈춘다. 파괴에 집착하던 눈동: (Bergelmir stops moving as cracks spread across its heart. Its eyes, once fixated on destruction, gradually change, almost seeming kind.)
Did I get it...? Ah, whenever I say that, they get up again...
strings.(베르겔미르가 자세를 고쳐 앉는다. 방금 전까지 공격적이었던 자세와는 대: (Bergelmir adjusts its position and sits down, a stark contrast to its aggressive stance a moment ago.)
'...You may lower your guard, guardian of this planet... The planetary reset was an error. The error has been fixed through debugging.'
strings.말이 어렵네. 다시 싸우는 일은 없다는 거지?: That's a lot of jargon. You mean we won't be fighting again?
'I will cease functioning soon. Before that, I need to tell you the truth.'
If you put it that way, I'll listen.
strings.「고맙다. 수호자. 그럼 이야기한다. 나는 베르겔미르. 악한 존재들이 많: 'Thank you, guardian. I will explain. I am Bergelmir, a weapon dispatched to destroy this place because it contained many evil beings.'
strings.「…하지만, 에트와르는 선량한 별이다. 악이 아니다. 베르겔미르는 이곳을: '...But Etoile is a good planet. Not evil. Bergelmir fought another evil that had come to destroy it.'
strings.「그러다 숲으로 떨어졌고, 기억을 잃었다. 차라리 깨어나지 않는 편이 좋: 'Then I fell into the forest and lost my memories. It would have been better not to awaken.'
strings.「…마을 사람들을 만나고, 에다를 만나서 좋았다.」: '...I was glad to meet the villagers. Glad to meet Edda.'
strings.에다…? 등에 이상한 괴물 팔을 달고 다니던 그 소녀? 그 아이는 날 공: Edda...? The girl with those strange monster arms on her back? She attacked me, then disappeared. I followed her and ended up here.
strings.「…그 아이는 죽었다. 사라지면서 별의 수호자에게 감사했다. 샤이닉을 도: '...That child has died. As she vanished, she thanked the planet's guardian. For helping Shynic, for destroying Ixion... for allowing her to escape the curse...'
strings.샤이닉? 익시온? 그게, 무슨 말이지? 저주는 또 뭐야?: Shynic? Ixion? What does that mean? And what curse?
strings.「에다는 죽음으로 저주에서 벗어났다. 하지만, 저들에게 똑같이 저주를 걸: 'Edda escaped the curse through death. But she placed that same curse upon them: the humans who destroyed this forest's everyday life...'
strings.「그 인간들도 마법사처럼 그 자에게 그 힘을 받았다. 에다도 그랬다. 에: 'Those humans received that power from him, just as the mage did. So did Edda. Edda's curse passed to the humans up ahead.'
strings.그러니까…. 그 저주란 게 모두 같은 저주, 모두 같은 힘, 그런 거라는: So... it's all the same curse? All the same power? What is this...?
strings.잠깐, 속박…. 속박의 힘?: Wait. Binding... The power of binding?
strings.「 거대한 에너지 스톤을 세우고 폭발시켰다. 사람들을 비롯한 일부 생명들: 'They erected a giant energy stone and detonated it. People and other living beings were crystallized. Their power was transferred to another space...'
strings.아즈라엘이 뭔데? 대체 아즈라엘이 뭐기에 생명들을 죽이는 거냐고!!: What is Azrael? What could Azrael possibly be that you'd kill living beings for it?!
strings.(베르겔미르의 목소리에 잡음이 섞여 제대로 들려오지 않는다.): (Static interferes with Bergelmir's voice, making it difficult to hear.)
strings.「고마웠다. 별의 수호자. 그리고….」: 'Thank you, guardian of the planet. And...'
strings.(갑자기 베르겔미르가 일어나 %s를 밀어낸다. 어디선가 날아온 불길한 힘: (Bergelmir suddenly rises and pushes %s aside. An ominous force flies in from somewhere, pierces Bergelmir's heart, and vanishes.)
strings.(%s의 발 밑으로 파괴된 베르겔미르의 심장 파편이 굴러떨어진다.): (Fragments of Bergelmir's shattered heart tumble to %s's feet.)
strings.(베르겔미르가 기동을 멈춘 채 더는 움직이지 않는다. ): (Bergelmir shuts down and moves no more.)
strings.(불안함이 느껴진다. 언젠가 느꼈던 그 느낌이다. ): (Unease settles over you. A feeling you've experienced before.)
strings.침착해, %s…. 복잡하게 생각할 필요 없어…. 나는 여기서 해야 할 일: Stay calm, %s... No need to overthink it... I only did what I had to do here...
If I tell Jin and leave the rest to the allied forces...
strings.…일단 이곳에서 나가자. 이렇게 쓸데없는 소리 하지 말고. 이, 일단 베: ...First, get out of here. Stop talking nonsense. I-I should take a fragment of Bergelmir's heart...
strings.(저 멀리 검은 갑옷을 입은 남자와 붉은 머리의 남성과 여성이 보인다.): (In the distance, you see a man in black armor and a red-haired man and woman.)
strings.(어떤 상황인지 알 수 없지만, 갑옷을 입은 남자의 손짓에 따라 붉은 머: (You can't tell what is happening, but the armored man's gestures make the red-haired man cry out in pain.)
strings.너희는 때가 되면 결과를 받아들인다고 했지. 이게 너희에게 주어진 결과…: You said you would accept the outcome when the time came. This is the outcome you have been given... You should have left this forest and that child alone.
strings.무, 무슨 소리야? 으으으, 그만. 내가 자, 잘못했어. 그러니까, 제발: Wh-what are you talking about? Urgh, stop. I-I was wrong. Please... What did I do to you? I gave you the improved magic stones!
strings.너라는 작은 그릇은 작은 힘만 담아야 했다. 어리석군. 끝냈어야 했는데,: A small vessel like you should have held only a little power. Foolish. You should have ended it, but you couldn't stop... That was your mistake.
Now disappear... into the deepest abyss...
strings.(고통을 호소하던 반의 뒤로 갑자기 거대한 구멍이 생긴다. 구멍의 안에서: (A vast opening suddenly appears behind the suffering Ban. Dozens, hundreds of black arms emerge and envelop him.)
strings.그, 그만!! 내, 내가 잘못했어!! 사, 살려줘!!: S-stop! I was wrong! P-please spare me!
strings.(반의 모습이 흐릿해지더니 연기처럼 흩어져 사라진다. 마치 세상에 없는: (Ban's form grows faint, then scatters like smoke and disappears, as though he no longer exists in this world.)
strings.(그 광경을 목격한 마라가 그대로 주저앉고 만다.): (Witnessing the scene, Mara collapses to the ground.)
Dit, where are you...? B-Ban... Sob... sob...
I know you're there, %s... Come out now.
strings.(진이 검을 쥔 손에 힘을 주고 있다. 금방이라도 바이스를 향해 달려들: (Jin tightens his grip on his sword, looking ready to charge at Weiss.)
strings.말리지 마. 나는, 내 나라는…. 데이모스 교단 때문에 반과 마라가, 저: Don't stop me. I... My kingdom... Because of the Deimos cult, Ban and Mara, those bastards... Urgh.
strings.진은 여기 있지 말고, 연합군에 합류해요. 여기는 어떻게든 내가 해볼게요: Don't stay here, Jin. Join the allied forces. I'll find a way to handle this. Trust me and go back. Take this, too. Evidence from Oneiro Forest...
All right. Then I'll leave the rest to you...
strings.(진이 고개를 끄덕이고 서둘러 연합군이 있는 방향으로 뛰어간다.): (Jin nods and hurries toward the allied forces.)
We have something to discuss. Not here, but on the reverse side...
strings.이면? 자, 잠깐…. 날 대체 어디로 데려가는 거야?!: The reverse side? W-wait... Where are you taking me?!
Where is this? It's definitely Moros, but...
strings.좋다, 이야기해 주지. 그는 네가 본 그대로, 필요한 곳에 쓰일 힘으로: Very well. I'll explain. As you saw, he returned to power that will be used where it is needed.
strings.필요한 곳에 쓰일 힘? 대체 수천, 수만의 생명으로 넌 뭘 한 거지? 그: Power used where it's needed? What have you done with thousands, tens of thousands of lives? And what is Azrael?
strings.대체 생명이 뭐라고 생각하는 거지?: What do you think a life is worth?
I have something to give you...
strings.적에게서 뭔가 받으라고? 제정신이야?: You want me to accept something from an enemy? Are you out of your mind?
strings.내가 이스트랜드에 머물면서 가지게 된 힘…. 초인이 가진 힘의 흔적이라: Power I acquired during my stay in Eastland... Call it a trace of a Champion's power.
strings.그게 없어도 나는 문제없다. 그래서 필요한 자에게 주겠다. 바로 너에게…: I have no need of it. So I will give it to someone who does. To you...
strings.네 힘은 필요없어. 다른 초인의 것만 있어도 돼!! 네가 주는 그 힘이: I don't need your power. The other Champions' power is enough! How am I supposed to know what you're giving me...?
strings.(바이스의 코웃음에 그동안 코랄시티와 괴물나무산, 마법학원 제레니스에서: (At Weiss's scoff, the unease and strange sensations you felt in Coral City, Monster Tree Mountain, and Xerenis Magic Academy all return at once.)
strings.그래, 이건 오래전부터 내가, 혹은 그가 계획했었던 일이었지. 넌 우습게: Yes. This was something I—or he—planned long ago. How amusing that you doubted your own god.
strings.(바이스가 손을 들어 살짝 흔든다.): (Weiss lifts his hand and moves it slightly.)
strings.(어디선가 이상한 힘이 다가와 온몸을 옭아맨다. 라피어에서 느꼈던 그 힘: (A strange force approaches from somewhere and binds your entire body. The power you felt in Lapier, the fear you felt recently at the academy...)
strings.너를 구속하는 이 힘은 온전히 내 것이지만, 너에게 주려는 힘은 내 것이: The power restraining you belongs entirely to me. But the power I'm giving you does not. Now you and I will each draw closer to our own 'end.'
strings.(바이스가 손을 펼치자 그 안에서 수상한 빛의 구가 떠오른다. 맑고 고운: (Weiss opens his hand, and an unfamiliar sphere of light rises from it. Clear and beautiful, the violet sphere leaves his palm and moves toward %s.)
strings.(바이스의 힘이 내게로 흐, 흡수되고 있어.): (Weiss's power is being a-absorbed into me.)
(But this... The traces of a Champion's power that Shynic and Atkina gave me... It feels just like that. Did he gain this power here?)
So you recognize that this power is the same as theirs.
strings.그래, 이 세계를 사랑했던 신들은 자신들의 힘을 이스트랜드에 남겼고, 남: Yes. The gods who loved this world left their power in Eastland. That power passed, undiminished, to those who had transcended humanity.
strings.…이걸로 널 보내긴 아쉬우니, 조금 더 고통을 주지. 더불어 다른 것도: ...It would be a shame to let you go like this. I'll give you a little more pain. And tell you something else.
strings.으아아아아악!! 크윽…. 그, 그게 대체…. 크아아아악!!: Aaaaaah! Guh... Wh-what could you... Gaaaaah!
strings.(바이스가 만족스러운 미소를 보이자 온 몸에 고통이 각인되는 것처럼 계속: (As Weiss smiles in satisfaction, pain continues surging through your body, as though engraving itself into you.)
I will be waiting at the 'end' you approach.
strings.(바이스가 뭐라고 하는지 제대로 들리지 않아….): (I can't make out what Weiss is saying...)
strings.(바이스의 목소리가 들리지 않아…. 얼굴도 제대로 보이지 않고….): (I can't hear Weiss's voice... I can't even see his face clearly...)
strings.(갑자기 바이스가 걸었던 힘의 고통이 떠오른다.): (The pain of Weiss's power suddenly returns to your mind.)
strings.(진의 외침에 어디선가 사제들이 달려온다. 사제들이 쓰러져 있는 %s의: (At Jin's call, priests hurry over. They examine the fallen %s and cast healing magic.)
Thank goodness. You don't have any serious injuries...
strings.이제, 이제 이곳의 일은 다 끝난 거죠…?: Is it... Is everything here over now...?
Everything in Moros is finished. The allied forces will handle the rest.
strings.혹시 이곳에서 바이스를 본 걸 다른 사람에게 이야기했나요? 아, 그 골렘: Did you tell anyone you saw Weiss here? Oh, what about the golem? What did you do with the heart fragment?
Sigh. I really don't understand you. You could find that out later.
strings.그래, 말해주지. 바이스를 본 건 아무에게도 이야기하지 않았다. 아니,: All right, I'll tell you. I haven't told anyone I saw Weiss. No—I won't tell anyone.
I'll hold on to the heart fragment, then entrust it to a Jewel School mage.
strings.또, 마라라는 그 여자는 실바리아 제국에서 직접 심문하기로 했다. 쥬드: As for Mara, the Silvaria Empire will interrogate her directly. The Kingdom of Jude has its own score to settle, but that will come later.
Yes, thank you. I'm fine now. I don't need any more healing.
You do seem better, but don't push yourself.
I'm going back to rest now.
strings.루맨에 자리를 마련할 테니 거기서 쉬는 건 어때?: I can arrange a place in Lumen. Why not rest there?
strings.아니에요. 제가 돌아가면 이리스에게 방해가 될테니…. 프레이오스에 갈 곳: No. If I go back, I'll get in Iris's way... There's somewhere I can go in Freios. I'll head there.
I don't know what awaits you, but I hope nothing else goes wrong.
And come see me in Lumen when you have time. There's something I'd like to discuss.
strings.(확실히 달라지긴 했어. 바이스에게 받은 힘 때문에 정신이 맑아지다니,: (Something has definitely changed. My mind feels clearer because of the power Weiss gave me... This is certainly a trace of a Champion's power.)
strings.(아, 모르겠다. 일단 데이나에게 가보자…. 그리고 당분간 아무것도 하지: (Ah, I don't know anymore. I'll go see Dayna first... Then do nothing for a while...)
strings.(데이나가 걱정스러운 표정으로 끌어안는다.): (Dayna embraces you, worry written across her face.)
strings.몸은 괜찮아? 어디 다친 곳 없고?: Are you all right? You're not hurt anywhere?
strings.(모로스에서 있었던 일을 간단하게 데이나에게 이야기한다.): (You briefly tell Dayna what happened in Moros.)
...Thank goodness. I can't say it enough. Thank goodness...
strings.후우…. 언니란 작자는 오랜만에 연락해와서 이런 일이나 주고. 엄한 사람: Sigh... That sister of mine finally gets in touch, only to give me a task like this. Making me play the villain who sends an innocent person into danger.
...Sorry. Just talking to myself. Don't mind me.
strings.그런 것치고 크게 말씀하시네요. 그런데 어디 다녀오셨어요? 상처가 있으신: Rather loudly, for talking to yourself. But have you been somewhere? You're wounded...
While you were there, %s, we had work of our own to do.
strings.약해진 틈을 찾아오는 무리들을 찾아 혼내줬지. 후우…. 하여튼, 고생했어: We tracked down the groups looking for a weak point to exploit and taught them a lesson. Sigh... Anyway, you've worked hard. Let the Empire's higher-ups handle the trouble for a while. Get some rest...
Thank you. This world owes you another debt.
So I'll be counting on you in the future, too. We may end up owing you again. Hehe.
Sigh. I suppose so. Thinking that this isn't the end makes me feel trapped all over again.
strings.고마운 게 한둘이 아니라서 어쩌지…. 저번에 동생을 도와준 것도 늦게 알: There are so many things I should thank you for... I only found out afterward that you helped my younger sister, too.
strings.그래, 저번에 제레니스 마법학원 일 말이야. 거기 학생회장 시이나가 내: Yes, at Xerenis Magic Academy. The student council president, Shiina, is my younger sister. Shiina Dawn Silvaria.
strings.아, 어쩐지 닮았더라. 잠깐, 뭐라구요? …이름 뒤에 던 실바리아? 어디: Oh, I thought you looked alike. Wait, what? ...Dun Silvaria? I've heard that name... When I received Her Majesty's decree...
strings.어라? 여기까지 왔는데, 알고 있는 거 아니었어?: Huh? You've come all this way, and you didn't know?
strings.어라, 반응을 보니 정말 몰랐나 보네. 후우…. 아하하하, 진짜 언니는…: Oh, judging by your face, you really had no idea. Sigh... Ahahaha! Honestly, that sister of mine... Ugh, never mind. You look tired, %s. Go rest at the guild inn. Ahahahaha...
strings.젤릭이 만든 음식도 잔뜩 보내 놓을테니 먹고 쉬는 거다. 알았지?: I'll have plenty of Zellic's cooking sent over. Eat and rest, all right?
Yes. All right. Let's talk later.
strings.그래, 나중…. 언제가 될지 모르지만, 뭐라도 이야기하고 싶을 때 다시: Yes, later... Whenever that is. Come see me again when you feel like talking about anything.
I will. I'll head to the inn.
strings.(데이나가 등을 떠미는 걸 보면 빨리 가야할 것 같다.): (With Dayna pushing you along, it seems best to leave quickly.)
strings.후우, 이래서 언니와 엮이는 건 싫어. 그래도 어쩔 수 없지. 내가 이렇: Sigh. This is why I hate getting involved with my sister. Still, it can't be helped. She's part of the reason I'm alive like this.
strings.(도시 안쪽의 어두운 그림자 속에서 카즈노라 이름 불린 자가 천천히 앞으: (The person called Kazno slowly steps out of the dark shadows deeper in the city.)
